column3: As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will build software that runs on real drones. You will take Auterion’s platform into a specific customer program and make it work on their hardware, for their mission, in the field.&lt

Your work will span autonomy, computer vision, video streaming and long-range radio links, on partner platforms across aerial, maritime and ground vehicles. What sets this role apart is that your work isn’t finished when the code is merged

Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.
Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.
Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.
Mit der Zeit wirst du ihre rechte Hand.

column1: werkstudent-ki-automatisierung-dusseldorf-434424,Lippe Personal GmbH,Werkstudent KI & Automatisierung (m/w/d),"Düsseldorf, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Deutschland",False,1795341111,"StellenbeschreibungHi, ich bin Felix Lippe.Vor ein paar Jahren habe ich Lippe Personal gegründet. Train, mentor, and provide quality oversight for Lease Analysts.&lt
Drive continuous improvement across lease administration workflows, reporting, controls, and system utilization.&lt
Serve as backup to the Lease Administration Manager during absences, including approvals, escalations, and time-sensitive decisions.&lt
Support Tax with VAT recovery activities as needed by region.&lt
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Real Estate, or a related field.&lt
5+ years of commercial real estate lease administration experience, preferably supporting data centers or other complex infrastructure portfolios.&lt
Strong understanding of ASC 842 / IRFS 16 and lease accounting principles.&lt
Demonstrated experience reviewing, interpreting, and administering complex commercial lease agreements and amendments.&lt
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with experience identifying discrepancies and resolving complex lease or billing issues.&lt
Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.&lt
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Finance, Accounting, Operations, Legal, and external partners.&lt
Experience with CoStar or a similar lease administration platform.&lt
Experience with Asana and Google Workspace.&lt
Familiarity with SOX controls and IFRS 16.&lt
Data center or infrastructure-related lease administration experience.&lt

column1: Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ?

Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu.

• Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données.

• Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing.
• Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science.

column3: Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs.&amp

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:&lt
Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion&lt
Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.&lt
Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.&lt
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.&lt
Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.&lt
Provide expert support (L3) to customers facing technical issues.&lt
Write clear and concise internal documentation, in addition to contributing to the public-facing knowledge base.&lt
Participate in daily stand-ups, as well as release planning and task prioritization meetings.&lt
B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.&lt
3+ years of experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python code in a professional setting.&lt
Extensive experience working with embedded architectures, including cross-compilation, debugging, and performance optimization.&lt
Expert Linux skills, with an excellent grasp of command line operations, resource management, systems services and networking.&lt
Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel, embedded device drivers, device tree configuration and u-boot.&lt
Experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Debian packaging workflows and managing complex Docker environments.&lt
Proficient in networking concepts across all layers of the OSI model, including connectors, and hardware interfaces, IP addressing, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.&lt
Skilled in using network diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump) to identify and resolve network issues.&lt
Basic embedded security knowledge, such as secure boot on embedded devices and/or UEFI, boot chain verification.&lt
Proven experience with network security protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS, VPNs) and best practices for securing embedded devices, such as secure boot and encryption mechanisms.&lt
Basic electrical engineering experience, such as familiarity with schematics and the instrumentation required to debug communication over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN bus.&lt
Bonus: Experience with video streaming and MIPI CSI drivers.&lt
Bonus: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms and their associated BSP packages.&lt
Bonus: Experience with NXP iMX8 platforms and their associated BSP packages.&lt
Bonus: Previous contributions to open source projects, especially in the Linux ecosystem.&lt
Bonus: Experience with CI/CD systems, such as Jenkins, GitHub actions, GitLab CI.&lt
Experience working in an agile environment, providing daily updates in stand-ups and managing tasks in a sprint board.&lt
A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives.&lt

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.&lt

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.&lt

Your job is to develop designers, raise the quality of the work, and make sure design has real influence on where the product goes. It is not a player-coach role, and it is not a step up for a strong IC looking for their first management position. We need someone who has already managed product designers and can do it well from day one.n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems your team tackles are complex. Design decisions have to account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes ripple across the whole platform. You'll need enough craft depth to recognise excellent work, challenge it constructively, and help designers get better. The team needs a manager whose design judgment they trust.You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now.More than 80% of workflows built on n8n involve AI agents, and we're widening from a developer audience to a broader set of builders. That shift is the central design problem here, and your team is at the centre of it.🎯 Your main goal is to build a Product Design team that consistently produces excellent work and shapes how n8n's product evolves. Here's what that involves:Lead and develop the teamRun regular, high-quality 1:1s and coach designers, design engineers and researchers across different levels.Own performance management: evidence-based reviews, honest feedback, and real support for anyone who isn't where they need to be.Help people understand what's expected at their level and what growth looks like, evolving our progression framework for Product Design.Hire excellent designers as the team grows, and broaden the range of backgrounds and perspectives on the team.Raise the design barSet and hold a high standard across problem framing, user understanding, interaction design, information architecture and visual craft.Facilitate design critiques and reviews that measurably improve the work, and help designers think beyond the feature in front of them.Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision.Own the whole product experienceKeep a holistic view across features and product areas, identifying inconsistencies, recurring UX problems, and opportunities for more coherent patterns.Work with the team to address fragmentation systematically rather than feature by feature.Make design a real partnerPartner closely with Product and Engineering leadership so design contributes early to problem definition and product direction, not late to execution.Help designers influence product decisions through strong reasoning rather than positional authority.Improve how the team works across critique, collaboration, decision-making and knowledge sharing, introducing structure where it helps the team scale and resisting process that slows things down.How much of this is hands-on?Worth being direct, because it's the question every good candidate asks. This is a management role: developing designers, raising the bar, and making design count in product decisions is the job, and that's where your time goes.You'll stay close to the craft in critiques, in reviews and in the detail of the work, and you'll occasionally pick up design work yourself. When that happens it sits outside the squads and varies with the period: an exploratory concept, a gap during someone's leave, a problem that needs a first pass. It is not a 50/50 split, and if what you want is to keep a squad's worth of delivery alongside managing the team, this isn't the role.REQUIREMENTSMust-haves👥 Proven design management: You've managed product designers in a product-led technology company for 3+ years, with a team of five or more. Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.&nbsp
On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,&nbsp
We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.

You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.

You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
Curious and able to ask insightful questions
A champion of a Growth Mindset
Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
Willingness to collaborate and influence in a ""win as a team"" environment
Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.

The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.

The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.&nbsp
On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,&nbsp
We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.

You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.

You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
Curious and able to ask insightful questions
A champion of a Growth Mindset
Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
Willingness to collaborate and influence in a ""win as a team"" environment
Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.

The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.

The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. column1: stage-data-science-clinical-ai-start-dec-2026-t-m-mrt-2027-amsterdam-48588,Pacmed,Stage Data Science & Clinical AI – start dec 2026 t/m mrt 2027,"Amsterdam, Noord-Holland, Netherlands",False,1795038696,"Wil je meebouwen aan de zorg van morgen met AI? Als stagiair bij Pacmed bouw je modellen die de besluitvorming in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen elke dag verbeteren. Je werkt met echte klinische data, samen met data scientists, engineers en clinici. We zoeken twee stagiairs die starten tussen december 2026 en maart 2027.Over PacmedBij Pacmed combineren we technologie en menselijkheid om de zorg toegankelijk en toekomstbestendig te houden. Onze software draait al in meerdere Nederlandse ziekenhuizen en we breiden actief verder uit. We helpen zorgprofessionals om real-time betere beslissingen te nemen, capaciteit efficiënter te benutten en patiëntenstromen soepel te laten verlopen. Als stagiair zit je precies op het punt waar onze modellen en data de klinische praktijk raken.Waarom Pacmed een ideale stageplek is:We zijn een scale-up met een duidelijke missie: de zorg toegankelijk en toekomstbestendig houden.Je werk doet ertoe. Het komt terecht in producten die in ziekenhuizen gebruikt worden, niet in een la.Je krijgt een begeleider die investeert in je ontwikkeling, en een team dat elkaar graag beter maakt.We gaan vriendelijk en respectvol met elkaar om en hebben graag plezier, met regelmatige teamuitjes en een jaarlijkse off-site.De twee stagesElke stagiair krijgt een eigen project. Beide projecten gaan over patiëntenstromen: hoeveel patiënten komen het ziekenhuis binnen, en hoeveel stromen er uit naar de nazorg.Stage 1: instroom voorspellen op de acute as (Capaciteitsmonitor)De Pacmed Capaciteitsmonitor geeft zorgprofessionals AI-voorspellingen op basis van real-time ziekenhuisdata, zodat ze personeel en capaciteit proactief kunnen plannen in plaats van reactief. De capaciteitsmonitor voorspelt patiëntbezetting en zorgzwaarte en vertaalt dat naar de daadwerkelijk benodigde personele capaciteit.We breiden deze aanpak nu uit naar andere afdelingen op de acute as: de spoedeisende hulp (SEH), de eerste harthulp (EHH) en de cardiac care unit (CCU). Daar houdt de personeelsplanning nog weinig rekening met schommelingen in de instroom, met over- en onderbezetting als gevolg.Sinds september 2026 werkt een stagiair aan instroommodellen voor deze afdelingen. Jij versterkt dat project en bouwt erop voort. Denk aan:modellen voor de SEH, EHH en CCU ontwikkelen en verbeteren op basis van ziekenhuisdata over instroom, uitstroom en bezetting en publieke data zoals weer, evenementen en epidemiologische gegevensde (potentiële) impact van de AI modellen op de personeelsplanning doorrekenenafdelingen (SEH, EHH, CCU) of ziekenhuizen met elkaar vergelijken
column2: de uitkomsten samen met clinici interpreteren en valideren.Stage 2: uitstroom naar de VVT voorspellen (Transfer Monitor)De Pacmed Transfer Monitor richt zich op een van de grotere inefficiënties in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen: vertraagde overplaatsing van patiënten naar de nazorg. Patiënten die medisch gezien niet meer in het ziekenhuis hoeven te liggen maar nog nergens terechtkunnen (""verkeerde bedden"") zijn naar schatting goed voor 5 tot 15% van de ligdagen in de ziekenhuizen waarmee we werken. Dat blokkeert de doorstroom vanaf bijvoorbeeld de SEH en het electieve programma, is vervelend voor patiënten, verhoogt het risico op complicaties en kost onnodig geld.De Transfer Monitor voorspelt vroeg en per patiënt of iemand nazorg nodig heeft en wat de verwachte ontslagdatum is. Zo kan het transferbureau bepalen welke patiënten het eerst gescreend worden, en kunnen artsen en verpleegkundigen het ontslag op tijd regelen.In deze stage gebruik je klinische data om te voorspellen hoeveel patiënten uitstromen naar VVT-instellingen (verpleeg- en verzorgingshuizen en thuiszorg). Daarmee kunnen die instellingen hun eigen capaciteit beter plannen. column1: venture-development-munich-169027,Tacto,Venture Development,Munich,False,1795156812,"About TactoTacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. As a Venture Developer, you own several hiring pipelines across functions, from Sales to Tech to Customer Value, and you help make Tacto the place where the best talent in Europe wants to work. Our own AI agents do much of the searching and first outreach, so about half of your week goes to what only people get to do: speaking to talent, judging fit and giving every candidate a great experience. afstudeerstage-ai-adoption-almere-35970,HG International b.v.,Afstudeerstage AI Adoption,"Almere, Flevoland, Nederland",False,1794940278,"Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen?Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt.Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten.Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.Wat ga je doen?Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie.Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen.“We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. column1: senior-software-engineer-hardware-in-the-loop-systems-munich-334384,TYTAN Technologies GmbH,"Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems (m/f/d)","Munich, Bayern, Germany",False,1795145482,"TYTAN TechnologiesThe PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build.You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change.Your roadmap to make an impactThe closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. Inject IMU, GNSS, camera and other sensor data at the interface the hardware expects, close the loop on actuator commands, and keep latency, jitter and time synchronisation within budget, so a flight on the rig behaves like a flight in the air.Fault injection: Sensor failures, GNSS denial and spoofing, link loss, bus errors and power faults, reproducible on demand.System rigs: Rigs for the current and next generation mission computer and for full system configurations with ground station, radio link and interceptors. Provisioned as code, with automated deployment of builds, remote power control, health monitoring and self-recovery.HIL in CI: Merge-gating regression suites, nightly and long-running mission suites, rig scheduling across pipelines, flaky test detection, and structured results traceable to requirements.Test framework: Fixtures for devices, instruments and simulators, so that a domain engineer writes a HIL test as easily as a unit test, and the same scenario runs in SIL and HIL.HIL as a product: Your users are our autonomy, perception and systems engineers. Availability and time to result are your metrics, also in restricted and air-gapped lab networks.  4+ years building HIL or hardware test systems for embedded or autonomous systems, including at least column8: Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vousLe Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés.Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux.Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de quatre ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée.Ce post-doc est organisé selon quatre axes de travail. Le premier axe de travail concernera l’utilisation de l’hydrogène pour favoriser la rupture intergranulaire, préalable indispensable à la spectrométrie Auger sur fracture. Ceci permettra d’accéder à des niveaux de ségrégation faibles, insuffisants pour provoquer une fragilité intergranulaire « intrinsèque ». L’hydrogène est connu pour exacerber, dans certains cas, la fragilité intergranulaire. Il s’agira ici d’explorer les conditions dans lesquelles on peut obtenir pour l’acier de cuve des ruptures intergranulaires assistées par l’hydrogène. On pourra notamment étudier l’effet de la concentration d’hydrogène (introduit par chargement cathodique par exemple) et de la vitesse de sollicitation mécanique. La chaire pourra bénéficier ici des compétences du laboratoire sur la fragilisation par l'hydrogène. Le deuxième axe de travail porte sur le développement d'un modèle quantitatif pour l'analyse par Auger de la ségrégation intergranulaire des éléments d'alliages. Il s'agira d'une approche similaire à celle déjà développée pour le phosphore et le soufre, avec la difficulté supplémentaire de soustraire la contribution du volume, ici non-négligeable. Les troisième et quatrième axes de ce post-doc s'appuient sur le spectromètre Auger installé en décembre 2025. Cet équipement de dernière génération présente une résolution latérale inférieure à 10 nm. Ceci ouvre de nouvelles perspectives d'analyses que nous souhaitons explorer dans le cadre de la chaire, en particulier concernant l'analyse du carbone et des carbures, qui constitue le troisième axe de travail de ce post-doc. L'analyse Auger de la surface des carbures nanométriques devient possible avec le nouvel instrument et permet d'accéder à la composition chimique des interfaces carbures-matrice. De plus, l'analyse Auger des facettes intergranulaires pourra être faite en-dehors des carbures et permettra d'accéder à la quantification du carbone ségrégé dans le joint. Enfin, le dernier axe de travail consistera à développer une méthode de quantification de la ségrégation intergranulaire sans rupture. Il s’agira de travailler ici sur une coupe polie du matériau à étudier et à réaliser des analyses locales, par exemple des profils de concentrations à travers les joints de grains. Compte tenu de l'excellente résolution latérale, on peut ainsi espérer détecter la ségrégation par cette méthode. Une méthode de traitement des données devra être développée pour accéder à des concentrations intergranulaires de solutés. Une telle méthode a déjà été mise au point pour des analyses réalisées par nanoSIMS et pourrait être transposée sur la spectrométrie Auger. Elle permettrait de s’affranchir de la nécessité d'obtenir une rupture intergranulaire (particulièrement limitante en spectrométrie Auger), tout en conservant une préparation d’échantillon très simple (coupe polie) et une productivité potentiellement importante (grand nombre de joints analysables dans un échantillon donné).  🔍 Ce que nous recherchonsVous êtes :·&nbsp

column10: Contexte :L'ammoniac (NH3) est un polluant atmosphérique nocif pour la santé humaine, les écosystèmes et l'environnement, mais aussi un précurseur de particules fines inorganiques notamment responsables de forts épisodes de pollution printaniers en Europe. column11: NH3 soit mesuré spécifiquement sur les supersites implantés dans des lieux caractéristiques de la pollution de fond rurale. La France répond à cette obligation en déployant 6 supersites de surveillance de typologie fond rural, répartis dans des zones représentatives de la pollution longue-distance, et sélectionnés au sein des stations de l’observatoire MERA. column2: we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.About the teamJoin the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, e-commerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people.About the roleEvaluation is the core of everything we do. We build from the evals: we define how success will be measured before developing a capability, and use the results to guide training, model selection and deployment. We already have hundreds of evaluations spanning domain knowledge, commerce and gaming, with plans to expand their coverage, depth and scale.This work builds on ProLLM, the public benchmarking platform we ran for real-world use cases until our coding assistant benchmarks became saturated. Since then it has been a private benchmarking platform for Prosus companies. We plan to open it again to publish our commerce benchmarks, covering both agentic and decision-making tasks.We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own the development of these evaluations and the platform that runs them. The work involves defining meaningful tasks, curating evaluation data, implementing reliable scoring, investigating model behaviour and making results useful for research and product decisions.In our flat team of around 30 engineers, you’ll work directly with applied scientists, training engineers and domain experts. You’ll help teams contribute evaluations and build the infrastructure and automation needed to run them throughout model development.In the first three months, we expect you to take technical ownership of part of the evaluation platform, deliver a set of new or improved evaluations with curated data and calibrated difficulty, and work with scientists to use them in a training or release decision.What the role involvesDesign evaluations with scientists and domain experts, translating intended capabilities into representative tasks, datasets and success criteria. Cover current applications and capabilities we want future models to acquire.Curate evaluation data and calibrate task difficulty, so that evaluations are neither saturated nor out of reach and still separate models of different quality. Work with domain experts on sourcing, annotation and review, within data provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy requirements.Own the development and operation of the evaluation platform across training checkpoints, deployed models and external baselines. Support distributed execution, reproducible configurations, trace inspection and comparison of results, while managing runtime and cost.Develop programmatic checks, outcome-based scoring and LLM-based graders. Calibrate automated judgments against expert reviews, investigate disagreements and test whether graders reward superficial answers or reject valid solutions.Analyse model outputs and agent trajectories, including tool calls, environment state and task outcomes. Distinguish model failures from problems in the evaluation, quantify uncertainty and explain what changed between versions.Maintain versioned tasks, datasets, graders and environments, with protected held-out tests and contamination checks. Expand coverage as models improve, retaining useful regression tests and adding harder tasks where existing tests no longer distinguish performance.Prepare commerce benchmarks for public release on ProLLM, including public mirror sets and evaluation code, where the data can be shared.Integrate evaluations into training and release workflows, with dashboards and regression checks that support concrete decisions. Work with portfolio teams to establish whether offline improvements correspond to better outcomes in online experiments.Build tools and agents that help generate candidate tasks, run evaluations and investigate failures, validating their outputs before adoption. Review contributions and mentor engineers so teams can extend the suite consistently.Minimum qualificationsAt least five years of ML or software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work building and evaluating ML systems.Experience owning evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or model-quality systems that informed training or deployment decisions.Strong Python and experience with PyTorch, Transformers or comparable ML libraries, alongside reliable production software development.Practical knowledge of experimental design and statistics, including sampling, uncertainty, repeated trials and comparisons across model versions.Experience running inference or evaluation workloads at scale and debugging failures across models, data, scoring code and infrastructure.Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous results into defensible recommendations.Preferred qualificationsExperience with language-model training or post-training.Experience with agent or gaming environments.Experience with human evaluation, LLM-as-judge calibration, recommendation metrics or online experimentation.Contributions to evaluation frameworks, public benchmarks or research.What we offerOwnership of the evaluation platform and the evaluations that guide LCM’s research, training and deployment.Access to proprietary domain data, GPU infrastructure and external models for comparison.Direct collaboration with researchers, engineers and portfolio teams, with scope to publish methods and benchmarks, including through ProLLM, where the work can be shared.Colleagues who have released Hugging Face models with more than 100 million downloads, authored papers at NeurIPS, created benchmarks and built multiple production AI systems.Current ML frameworks and unlimited access to coding assistants.A base at our Amsterdam office and AI House, with relocation support. We also consider remote arrangements for candidates with particularly strong experience relevant to the role.Competitive compensation and a top-spec MacBook Pro.If you want to build the evaluations that shape what a foundation model learns, we’d like to hear from you. Please include examples of evaluations or platforms you have built, how you established that their results were reliable, and the decisions those results informed.Why Prosus?At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. column3: we are looking for depth in one or more of them.The role involves designing experiments, writing the code to run them, analysing results and developing training methods that other teams can use. Scientists own the research questions, training objectives and evidence needed to decide whether a change works, and work with ML engineers to turn successful experiments into reliable training runs. We are a team of around 30 engineers with a flat structure, working directly with portfolio companies to define problems, evaluate models and bring successful work into production.In the first three months, the expectation is to establish strong baselines in a chosen research area, develop and evaluate an improvement, and work with the relevant teams to test it in a downstream application.Track 1: Pre-trainingThis track focuses on continued pre-training of open-weight models on commerce data, including how we represent that data, allocate training compute and transfer capabilities to smaller models. Research areas include:Studying scaling behaviour, data mixtures and compute allocation to decide what goes into the next training run.Developing mid-training methods, including data refinement, annealing schedules, context extension and alignment between text and semantic IDs for users, items and merchants.Designing training sequences from user histories, merchant catalogues and market data, and studying how representations transfer across companies, languages and commerce categories.Building synthetic data pipelines and measuring their contribution through controlled comparisons with real data.Distilling the base model into smaller models, including through on-policy distillation, and measuring the trade-offs between quality, inference cost and latency.Developing evaluations that help select pre-training runs and predict downstream performance, including checks for temporal leakage, generalisation to new users and items, and retention of existing capabilities.Tabular foundation models are a possible specialisation: pre-training and in-context learning on structured commerce data, using synthetic and real tables and comparing results with established tabular methods.Relevant experience includes continued pre-training or mid-training, data mixture research, scaling laws, tokenisation, entity representations, distillation, or tabular foundation models such as TabPFN and TabICL.Track 2: Post-training and continual learningThis track focuses on adapting LCM to commerce tasks and learning from interactions after deployment. The goal is to turn signals from a continuous stream of billions of user sessions across the portfolio into regular updates to model weights, while retaining the capabilities the model has already learned. Research areas include:Developing post-training methods using supervised fine-tuning, preference optimisation such as DPO, and reinforcement learning with verifiable or learned rewards, including GRPO and PPO.Learning from session histories, searches, clicks, purchases, repeat orders and operator feedback. This includes data selection, credit assignment and reward design that account for exposure bias, delayed outcomes and the difference between observed engagement and incremental business value.Studying how to combine new interactions with historical data, how frequently to update models, when an update is ready for deployment, and how to preserve performance as user behaviour and catalogues change.Building RL environments with simulated users, catalogues and multi-step commerce tasks, including inspecting trajectories, validating rewards and testing whether improvements in simulation transfer to real interactions.Developing reward models and LLM-based graders, calibrating them against expert judgments and observed outcomes, and testing for reward hacking, sycophancy and excessive concentration on popular items.Training decision models for rankings, offers and promotions using contextual bandits or offline RL, with off-policy evaluation to estimate value and uncertainty, identify gaps in the available evidence and inform controlled online experiments.Developing automated experiments that propose and test changes to training methods, prompts, tools or agent control flow, evaluated on held-out tasks and regression tests before acceptance.Relevant experience includes language-model post-training, reinforcement learning, reward modelling, agent training environments, continual learning, or offline RL and bandits applied to real decisions. The training experience required will depend on the research direction.Responsibilities across both tracksDefine success with portfolio teams and evaluate models against strong baselines, including existing production systems, accounting for inference cost, latency and the business outcome the model is meant to improve.Design reproducible experiments with appropriate ablations, uncertainty estimates and failure analysis, using future-period and held-out evaluations, and test whether offline improvements hold online.Work with data and engineering teams on provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy-aware handling of customer histories.Publish research and contribute models, benchmarks, environments and training methods to open source where the work and data can be shared.Mentor colleagues, review experiment designs and communicate findings clearly enough to support training and deployment decisions.Minimum qualificationsA PhD or equivalent industry research experience in machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related field.At least five years of research or applied science experience in machine learning, including doctoral research, with hands-on experience designing and running model-training experiments. Work may include:Studying data mixtures, scaling behaviour and training schedules to guide the next run.Designing sequences from user histories, merchant catalogues and market data, including alignment between text and semantic IDs for users, items and merchants.Developing mid-training methods for capability acquisition, context extension and retention of general capabilities.Evaluating synthetic data and distillation methods through controlled experiments, including the trade-offs between quality, inference cost and latency.Studying transfer across languages, markets and commerce categories, with evaluations for new users and items and for performance on future data.Tabular foundation models are a possible specialisation, including pre-training and in-context learning on structured commerce data.Post-training and continual learningWe train LCM for commerce tasks and a range of agent applications, including customer-facing assistants and agents that carry out business operations. column1: remote-financial-crime-lead-175628,Finary,Financial Crime Lead,Remote,True,1795113630,"What is Finary?Money is broken: most people’s wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see. We are putting a private banker in everyone’s pocket, with the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us. Finary AI turns that context into a plan, and our investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real.Why now?AI makes this possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy: years of per-user financial data that no public dataset holds, a brand that brings in half of our new users through our own channels, and licences (PSAN, Investment Firm, MiCA) we secured before they became mandatory. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest. Founders and leaders from Qonto, Photoroom, Bitpanda, UBS and Wise also invested.What we offerWe’re 70 builders with real ownership from day 1, tier-1 salary and equity, and offices in central Paris with hybrid remote. Our culture is direct and built on radical candor. AI is a real bar here: everyone has rebuilt how they work around it. Read more about our values here.The opportunityMore than 1M people track and grow their wealth with Finary. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination.Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory and control. Each role covers every licence. Reporting to our Head of Compliance, who is our AML/CFT officer, you'll work alongside our AML analyst and take ownership of the framework that protects our clients and our licences, with most of our exposure in crypto.What you'll doLead the AML/CFT framework: procedures, client risk classification, detection rules and tools (screening, blockchain analytics, Travel Rule), calibrated on our own data.Investigate and decide the hard cases: enhanced reviews of individuals and companies (ownership chains, financial statements, flows), on-chain investigations, decisions on suspicion.Draft and file suspicious transaction reports, and act as deputy TRACFIN declarant and correspondent.Handle screening and asset freezing: PEP, sanctions and adverse media hits, list updates.Build with AI: design and tune the agents and rules in our back-office tool that prepare files and clear first-level reviews, and keep the decision on suspicion human.Work with Ops, Care, Product and our outsourced review team so that AML decisions are clear, fast and fair to the honest majority of our clients.What we're looking forYou've spent 6 to 8 years in AML/CFT in financial services, including hands-on work at a crypto-asset service provider (PSAN/CASP).You've drafted and filed suspicious transaction reports with TRACFIN yourself.You investigate on-chain: you use blockchain analytics tools and you know the Travel Rule and self-hosted wallets.You hold a certification in on-chain analysis (Chainalysis CCI, CCCA or CRC, or a TRM Labs or Elliptic equivalent) and a Travel Rule certification (Notabene NB-TRFC or equivalent).You work with data and AI every day: you query data yourself and you already use AI in your reviews or investigations. This is a must, not a plus.You decide on evidence, you keep weak signals in proportion, and you explain your decisions clearly.You prioritise a growing queue by risk without missing a legal deadline, and you move the framework forward at the same time.Fluent French and professional English.This role is not for you if you'd rather stay on onboarding checks, you prefer advising to deciding, or you need a large financial crime department and mature tools before you can start.You don't tick every box? Apply anyway if you've done the core of the job: investigating cases, deciding them and filing the reports.InterviewsInterviews with French-speaking candidates are held in French. column2: Projet FLOWATTLe projet FLOWATT, dans le cadre duquel s’inscrit cette étude, vise à déployer et exploiter six hydroliennes dans les forts courants marins du Raz Blanchard, en Normandie.Au-delà de la production d’énergie, FLOWATT a pour objectif d’évaluer le potentiel du Raz Blanchard pour le déploiement de fermes hydroliennes à plus grande échelle. Cette évaluation repose notamment sur une caractérisation précise de la ressource, une estimation fine du productible et une meilleure compréhension des impacts environnementaux. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, le projet combine mesures in situ, modélisation numérique et essais expérimentaux afin de fournir les connaissances nécessaires à la préparation des futurs déploiements commerciaux, tout en contribuant à la réduction des coûts de production et à la limitation des impacts sur l’environnement marin.Dans ce contexte, la caractérisation de l’état de mer constitue un enjeu important, notamment dans une zone soumise à des courants très intenses. La présente étude s’intéresse ainsi aux données de radar HF acquises depuis fin 2017, ainsi qu’à celles qui seront nouvellement enregistrées dans le cadre du projet TidalRace. Le système, de technologie WERA, est réparti sur deux sites distants d’environ 5 km au Cap de la Hague et fonctionne à deux fréquences, 13,5 MHz et 24,5 MHz. Les acquisitions sont réalisées en continu, à raison de quatre mesures par heure, 24 h/24 et 7 j/7, sur une emprise couvrant l’ensemble du Raz Blanchard. Cette couverture temporelle et spatiale offre ainsi une opportunité unique de suivre l’évolution des états de mer dans des conditions hydrodynamiques particulièrement contraintes.L’exploitation de ces données nécessite toutefois d’adapter les méthodes de traitement aux conditions de forts courants. L’objectif des travaux est donc d’améliorer les algorithmes existants et, si nécessaire, d’en développer de nouveaux afin de restituer de manière fiable les spectres d’énergie des vagues en fréquence et en direction, ainsi que les paramètres moyens associés. Une première étape consistera à comprendre les limites des méthodes actuelles, qui ne permettent plus de restituer un état de mer cohérent avec les références disponibles lorsque la vitesse du courant dépasse 1 m/s, comme montré par Lopez et al. (2018). Les méthodes développées seront ensuite évaluées à partir des mesures in situ et des modélisations numériques. Le radar HF constitue ainsi un élément central de ce travail, dont l’amélioration doit permettre de mieux caractériser les états de mer dans les forts courants du Raz Blanchard.Missions / Activités principales&nbsp

column1: ai-product-manager-lille-30774,Hubvisory,AI Product Manager,"Lille, Hauts-de-France, France",False,1795080688,"Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN. column1: country-executive-paris-272031,Light Inc,Country Executive,Paris,False,1795038012,"Country ExecutiveThe Finance Function Is Broken. Everyone Building For It Is Boring.Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job.Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week.What we don’t have yet is someone who owns each market as their own. We’re hiring Country Executives across several markets. Tell us which one is yours.This Is Not A Country Manager Role.Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else.No local playbook. You’ll be the person who owns your market, and within a year you should know its complexity (its rules, its buyers, its excuses) better than anyone else. It’s not a leadership title. It’s the seed of one. Do this right and there’s a real path: stand up an entity, build the team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM.What You’ll Be DoingSitting across from finance leaders. Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You find out what they actually need, the thing behind the thing they asked for, and you come back with it written down clearly enough for engineers to build against.Being the connective tissue. Customer, product, commercial. What you learn in-market changes how Light builds and how Light sells. You are the wire between them, and the wire has to carry current in both directions.Owning the local rulebook. Compliance, regulation, filing, the specific ways finance is done badly in your country. You’re the person in the room who knows this, and you make sure it shows up in the product and in the pitch.Having a public point of view. Ideally you arrive with a finance background and an opinion on what “doing finance right” looks like in your market. Bring it into the market, into the roadmap, and into how every prospect sees Light. Relationships, events, brand presence: built by you.Closing, with London behind you. Our sales team helps you manage and push deals over the line. You bring the market and customer understanding that makes those conversations land. They support you
column2: they don’t carry you, and you don’t carry it alone.How We’ll Keep ScoreThis isn’t a pure revenue seat, but growing your country’s ARR is the primary goal and you’re tied directly to that number. software-test-engineer-80-100-bern-79595,machineMD,Software Test Engineer 80–100%,Bern,False,1794921471,"As our Software Test Engineer at machineMD in Bern, you’ll bring your engineering skills to a practical challenge: making complex systems easier to test. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. column1: steuerfachkraft-fur-digitalisierung-ki-hamburg-306810,Nexus Gruppe,Steuerfachkraft für Digitalisierung & KI (m/w/d),Hamburg,False,1795068061,"Du kennst DATEV aus dem Kanzleialltag und weißt genau, wo Zeit verloren geht: doppelte Eingaben, Nacharbeit, Medienbrüche, unnötige Klickstrecken. Wir suchen eine Steuerfachkraft für Digitalisierung & KI (m/w/d) für die Nexus Gruppe in Hamburg.

Du musst selbst keine Software entwickeln. Die technische Umsetzung übernimmt unser Entwickler. Entscheidend ist, dass du Kanzleiprozesse fachlich verstehst und Anforderungen so beschreiben kannst, dass daraus funktionierende Lösungen entstehen. Wenn du Lust hast, selbst Automatisierungen zu bauen, zeigen wir dir die Werkzeuge dafür.
Deine Arbeit hat direkten Praxisbezug: Was ihr entwickelt, wird in den Partnerkanzleien eingesetzt, getestet und weiterentwickelt.
Was dich bei der Nexus Gruppe erwartet:
Du nimmst bestehende Prozesse in den Kanzleien auf und erkennst, welche Schritte sich durch KI oder Automatisierung sinnvoll unterstützen lassen.
Du entwickelst daraus Standardprozesse, die alle Kanzleien im Verbund nutzen können.
Du beschreibst fachliche Anforderungen so genau, dass unser Entwickler daraus Automatisierungen, KI-Assistenten und Workflows bauen kann.
Du sorgst mit deinem DATEV-Wissen dafür, dass die Lösungen im Kanzleialltag wirklich funktionieren.
Du testest neue Lösungen gemeinsam mit den Anwendern in den Kanzleien und bewertest Qualität, Verständlichkeit und Praxistauglichkeit.
Du holst Rückmeldungen aus den Kanzleien ein und leitest daraus die nächsten Entwicklungsschritte ab.
Du legst fest, wo beim Einsatz von KI fachliche Prüfung nötig bleibt und wo die Grenzen liegen.
Du begleitest Einführung, Dokumentation und Schulung in den Partnerkanzleien.

Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r, Steuerfachwirt/in, Bilanzbuchhalter/in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Auch ein anderer Hintergrund ist willkommen, wenn du die Abläufe in Steuerkanzleien aus mehrjähriger Praxis kennst.

column1: research-lead-evaluations-freiburg-378497,Black Forest Labs,"Research Lead, Evaluations",Freiburg (Germany),False,1795059806,"About Black Forest LabsWe’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.Why This RoleBFL’s research organization is split into different focus areas, such as pre-training, post-training, reinforcement learning, data, representation learning, evaluations and more. During the day to day work, researchers from these different focus areas work together to solve exciting and hard problems towards solving visual intelligence.Having the right means to measure what matters is the central starting point for every research project. Researchers make decisions based on the outcomes of evaluations. The right decision can only be made if an evaluation is precise and accurate. As the Evaluations Lead you’re the core driver to ensure that. Central responsibilities include building our eval roadmap in collaboration with the research and product teams, managing and extending our evaluation team, and cross-functional work with project leads to make sure each research project has the best evaluation toolbox to help the people working on it to make the right decisions. Finally, you’re responsible for growing the people in your team and maintain an eye on their long term development during the daily project work.What You’ll Work OnDefining what we evaluate: You are the core driver to create, maintain and extend our evaluations roadmap by collaborating with the product and other research leads who provide the required input.Defining how we evaluate: You’ll work with the team to implement our evals roadmap. This includes building new evals. Both benchmarks and the necessary objective functions, involving both automated, AI-based, and human evaluations.Minimizing noise in our eval pipeline: Developing frontier AI system requires the most accurate means to measure what matters! You will ensure that results are reproducible and trustworthy, that we understand the error bars behind them and that we measure what we want to measure.Understanding what we cannot measure: You’re responsible for highlighting and clearly communicate limitations of each individual evaluation and you will support our project teams to ensure that their chosen set of evaluations has no blind spots in when combined. ****Observing training runs and visualizing important findings: You will help with monitoring our most critical training runs from an independent standpoint to ensure that regressions and emerging capabilities are caught early and are clearly communicated.Managing our evals team: Your role is a hands-on management role - you’re responsible for growing the team and the people in it. You will define our hiring roadmap and make sure that each team member can grow within BFL, both in terms of their technical skillset and their career.What We’re Looking ForProven eval experience: You’ve previously designed, run and maintained large and complex evaluation suites for frontier AI systems, involving various kinds of evaluation methods involving both human and automated (both with or without AI) approaches.Strong research background: You should have proven experience of designing and implementing evaluations for AI research. Strong understanding of Python is required. A strong understanding of agentic coding is a must.Experience as a people manager: One of your core responsibilities will be to grow the team and its members. Understanding what it means to lead a team and how it’s different from an IC role is a must. You should have actively managed a team for at least one year.Strong understanding in statistics and good judgement about numbers: You should be familiar with variance, confidence intervals and significance testing. You should be able to identify and resolve situations when blindly trusting numbers leads to wrong conclusions.Excellent communication skills: You will have to communicate results with project leads and research leadership. Understanding how to communicate these results and what they don’t tell us is important since they’re the foundation for important decisions.First principles thinking: Crafting evaluations for new capabilities is not straightforward. You need to be able to derive new evals which requires proficiency in thinking from first principlesPrior experience in visual multimodal AI systems is a plus: Ideally you should bring experience in evaluating visual AI systems. Being familiar with additional modalities (audio, language/code, action prediction) for both generation and understanding/detection will be helpful.How We Work TogetherWe’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in Freiburg, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week.Everything we do is grounded in four values:Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.CompensationEUR255K- 295K + equity, depending on profileNote: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow","['python', 'excel']",2

column3: We are looking for a senior Systems Software Engineer to join our Runtime Software team at Oxford Ionics / IonQ.
